description: This Java class 'ModelReader' is responsible for reading, parsing, and managing entity model definitions within the OFBiz framework. It loads entity configurations from XML resources, constructs entity objects, manages entity cache, and auto-generates relationships among entities.

classes.name: ModelReader
classes.description: Final class responsible for reading and managing entity model definitions, caching entities, and handling relationships within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModelReader
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a ModelReader instance for a given delegator name, with caching.

methods.name: getEntityCache
methods.description: Loads and caches all entity definitions from XML resources if not already loaded.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns a set of all entity names loaded.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ModelEntity by name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getModelEntityNoCheck
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelEntity by name without throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: getEntityNamesIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all entity names.

methods.name: getEntitiesByPackage
methods.description: Returns entities organized by package, filtered by provided sets.

methods.name: validateEntityName
methods.description: Validates and adjusts an entity name by stripping invalid leading characters.

methods.name: createModelEntity
methods.description: Creates a ModelEntity from an XML element.

methods.name: createModelViewEntity
methods.description: Creates a ModelViewEntity from an XML element.

methods.name: createRelation
methods.description: Creates a ModelRelation for a given entity and relation XML element.

methods.name: incrementFieldCount
methods.description: Increments the total field count for statistics.
